METHOD AND TIMINGS:
- Indiana recipe (works well, ~5-6 min per plant): CAATS (caats.idem.in.gov, Playwright: 'By Source Name and County') gives the source ID and permit numbers; issued permits download directly as https://permits.air.idem.in.gov/<permit-number>f.pdf (text PDFs); everything else (applications, company NESHAP reports, inspections) comes from IDEM's Virtual File Cabinet search API: GET https://ecm.idem.in.gov/cs/idcplg?IdcService=GET_SEARCH_RESULTS&QueryText=xSourceID <matches> `099-00054`&IsJson=1, then GET_FILE&dID=<dID>&Rendition=web. No account needed.
- North Carolina (~6 min): Laserfiche WebLink at edocs.deq.nc.gov/AirQuality; Search.aspx?searchcommand={LF:Name="<facility id>",Type="F"} opens the facility folder; ElectronicFile.aspx?docid=<id>&dbid=0&repo=AirQuality returns the PDF. Inspection reports describe processes in prose.
- Louisiana (~12 min, failed at the last step): EDMS v2 POST /edmsv2/aiSearch/filter and /edmsv2/documentSearch/filter return JSON; documents are image-rendered.
- Minnesota (~12 min, failed): WIMN API JSON works intermittently; downloads captcha-blocked.
- Illinois (~6 min): Document Explorer search works; DocuWare viewer errors; small sources often absent.
- Michigan, Missouri, North Dakota, South Dakota (~2-4 min each): no permit for the target (small welding shops are usually exempt or unpermitted).
source_failures: MPCA What's in My Neighborhood (services.pca.state.mn.us/api/v1/wimn): site and document-list JSON works intermittently with curl; Radware bot manager blocks bursts, and document downloads (sites/documents/document?documentId=) always redirect to a Radware captcha, in curl and headless Chromium.

IEPA Document Explorer (webapps.illinois.gov/EPA/DocumentExplorer): facility search works in Playwright; the DocuWare document list it links to returns 'Error occurred during a cryptographic operation' and no documents.

LDEQ EDMS (edms.deq.louisiana.gov): AI lookup and document search work as JSON APIs; the document viewer (app/doc/view?doc=) renders page images and the download is a client-side blob; no direct PDF URL found.
IDEM permits.air.idem.in.gov root returns 403, but <permit>f.pdf files fetch directly; draft/application permits (e.g. 50753) are not there and come from the VFC search.
Michigan EGLE Sources_By_SRN.pdf returned 503 (HTML); Active PTIs by County.pdf works.
North Dakota DEQ: no public permit document search; permits appear only on the public-notice page during comment periods.
